```{r setup, include=FALSE}
meta       <- active_meta(load_meta())
goal_rows  <- meta[as.character(meta$goal) == as.character(params$goal), , drop = FALSE]

# Columns that are usually grouping / categorical
GROUP_COL_CANDIDATES <- c(
  "Community", "Location", "Geography", "ZIP", "District",
  "School District", "County", "Region", "Group", "Category",
  "Cohort", "Grade", "Age", "Age Group", "Race", "Ethnicity",
  "Race/Ethnicity", "Type", "Classification", "Subject", "Status"
)

# -- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------

as_numeric_safe <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[,$%]", "", as.character(x))))
}

# Parse Year strings liberally: "2019" -> 2019, "2014-2015" -> 2014,
# "20-02" (YY-MM) -> NA (so we fall back to factor on the raw string).
parse_year <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(integer(0))
  s <- as.character(x)
  m <- regmatches(s, regexpr("(?<!\\d)(19|20)\\d{2}", s, perl = TRUE))
  out <- rep(NA_integer_, length(s))
  ok  <- regexpr("(?<!\\d)(19|20)\\d{2}", s, perl = TRUE) > 0
  out[ok] <- as.integer(m)
  out
}

year_is_numeric_like <- function(x) {
  yy <- parse_year(x)
  sum(!is.na(yy)) >= max(2L, ceiling(0.6 * length(x)))
}

filter_years <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || !"Year" %in% names(df)) return(df)
  yn <- parse_year(df$Year)
  if (!all(is.na(yn))) {
    if (!is.null(params$yr_start)) {
      df <- df[is.na(yn) | yn >= as.integer(params$yr_start), , drop = FALSE]
      yn <- parse_year(df$Year)
    }
    if (!is.null(params$yr_end)) {
      df <- df[is.na(yn) | yn <= as.integer(params$yr_end), , drop = FALSE]
    }
  }
  df
}

# Classify each column: is it numeric-like, categorical, or the Year column?
detect_columns <- function(df) {
  cols <- names(df)
  # Columns we never want to plot or use as grouping.
  ignore_c <- intersect(cols, c("Source", "Notes", "Note", "Comment",
                                "Comments", "Month", "Day"))

  # Numeric columns: values mostly parseable as numbers.
  numeric_c <- cols[vapply(df, function(x) {
    if (is.numeric(x)) return(TRUE)
    v <- as_numeric_safe(x)
    sum(!is.na(v)) >= max(2L, ceiling(0.6 * length(v)))
  }, logical(1))]
  numeric_c <- setdiff(numeric_c, c("Year", ignore_c))

  # Grouping columns: anything left that's not numeric, not Year, not ignored.
  group_c <- setdiff(cols, c(numeric_c, "Year", ignore_c))

  # Is Year a real year series (e.g. 2010, 2011, ...) or categorical
  # (e.g. "2014-2015", "20-02", "2009-11")?
  year_num <- "Year" %in% cols && year_is_numeric_like(df$Year)

  list(
    numeric    = numeric_c,
    group      = group_c,
    has_year   = "Year" %in% cols,
    year_num   = year_num
  )
}

coerce_numeric_cols <- function(df, cols) {
  for (cc in cols) df[[cc]] <- as_numeric_safe(df[[cc]])
  df
}

# Drop columns/factor-levels with all-NA values so charts stay readable.
drop_empty_levels <- function(df, col) {
  df[[col]] <- factor(df[[col]], levels = unique(stats::na.omit(df[[col]])))
  df
}

# Build the chart best suited to the data. Returns NULL if nothing useful
# can be drawn, so we skip silently.
build_chart <- function(df, title) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  info <- detect_columns(df)
  if (length(info$numeric) == 0) return(NULL)

  df <- coerce_numeric_cols(df, info$numeric)
  val  <- info$numeric[[1]]
  grps <- info$group
  has_year <- info$has_year
  year_num <- info$year_num

  # Helper: the x-axis column + whether it should be treated as continuous.
  x_col     <- if (has_year) "Year" else if (length(grps) >= 1) grps[[1]] else NULL
  x_is_time <- has_year && year_num
  # Pick remaining grouping columns (those not used as x).
  other_grps <- if (has_year) grps else setdiff(grps, x_col)

  # ── Case 1: x = Year + two grouping columns (facet by one, fill by other) ──
  if (!is.null(x_col) && length(other_grps) >= 2) {
    facet_by <- other_grps[[1]]
    fill_by  <- other_grps[[2]]
    d <- df[!is.na(df[[val]]), , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(d) >= 2) {
      xmap <- if (x_is_time) aes(x = parse_year(.data[[x_col]])) else aes(x = factor(.data[[x_col]]))
      p <- ggplot(d, aes(y = .data[[val]], fill = .data[[fill_by]])) +
        xmap +
        geom_col(position = position_stack()) +
        facet_wrap(as.formula(paste0("~`", facet_by, "`")), scales = "free_y") +
        labs(title = title,
             x = if (x_is_time) "Year" else x_col,
             y = val, fill = fill_by)
      return(style_plot(p))
    }
  }

  # ── Case 2: x = Year (numeric) + one grouping col ──
  # If the grouping looks like a location comparison (Community / District /
  # County / Geography / Location / ZIP / Region), draw a multi-series line,
  # matching the reference report's Community-comparison charts.
  # Otherwise (Age, Race, Classification, Cohort, Type, Category, etc.)
  # draw a stacked bar so the parts-of-whole story comes through.
  LOCATION_GRPS <- c("Community", "Location", "Geography", "ZIP", "District",
                     "School District", "County", "Region")
  if (!is.null(x_col) && has_year && year_num && length(other_grps) == 1) {
    grp <- other_grps[[1]]
    d   <- df[!is.na(df[[val]]), , drop = FALSE]
    d$._yr <- parse_year(d[[x_col]])
    d   <- d[!is.na(d$._yr), , drop = FALSE]
    n_grp <- length(unique(d[[grp]]))
    is_location <- grp %in% LOCATION_GRPS

    if (nrow(d) >= 2 && is_location && n_grp <= 12) {
      # Multi-series comparison over time.
      p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = ._yr, y = .data[[val]],
                         colour = .data[[grp]], group = .data[[grp]])) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
        geom_point(size = 2) +
        labs(title = title, x = "Year", y = val, colour = grp)
      return(style_plot(p))
    } else if (nrow(d) >= 2 && n_grp <= 12) {
      # Parts of a whole (or ordered categories) → stacked bar by year.
      p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = factor(._yr), y = .data[[val]],
                         fill = .data[[grp]])) +
        geom_col(position = position_stack(), width = 0.8) +
        labs(title = title, x = "Year", y = val, fill = grp) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
      return(style_plot(p))
    } else if (nrow(d) >= 2) {
      # Fallback if grouping has too many levels to be useful.
      p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = ._yr, y = .data[[val]], group = .data[[grp]])) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.6, colour = "#2C6E49", alpha = 0.6) +
        labs(title = title, x = "Year", y = val)
      return(style_plot(p))
    }
  }

  # ── Case 3: x = Year (categorical/period) + one grouping col → grouped bar ──
  if (!is.null(x_col) && has_year && !year_num && length(other_grps) == 1) {
    grp <- other_grps[[1]]
    d   <- df[!is.na(df[[val]]), , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(d) >= 2) {
      d[[x_col]] <- factor(d[[x_col]], levels = unique(d[[x_col]]))
      p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = .data[[x_col]], y = .data[[val]],
                         fill = .data[[grp]])) +
        geom_col(position = position_dodge(preserve = "single"), width = 0.8) +
        labs(title = title, x = x_col, y = val, fill = grp) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
      return(style_plot(p))
    }
  }

  # ── Case 4: x = Year (numeric) alone → bar by year ──
  if (!is.null(x_col) && has_year && year_num && length(other_grps) == 0) {
    d <- df[!is.na(df[[val]]), , drop = FALSE]
    d$._yr <- parse_year(d[[x_col]])
    d <- d[!is.na(d$._yr), , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(d) >= 2) {
      p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = factor(._yr), y = .data[[val]])) +
        geom_col(fill = "#2C6E49", width = 0.7) +
        labs(title = title, x = "Year", y = val)
      return(style_plot(p))
    }
  }

  # ── Case 5: x = Year (categorical) alone → bar by period ──
  if (!is.null(x_col) && has_year && !year_num && length(other_grps) == 0) {
    d <- df[!is.na(df[[val]]), , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(d) >= 2) {
      d[[x_col]] <- factor(d[[x_col]], levels = unique(d[[x_col]]))
      p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = .data[[x_col]], y = .data[[val]])) +
        geom_col(fill = "#2C6E49", width = 0.7) +
        labs(title = title, x = x_col, y = val) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
      return(style_plot(p))
    }
  }

  # ── Case 6: no Year, one categorical + numeric → horizontal ranked bar ──
  if (!has_year && length(grps) >= 1) {
    grp <- grps[[1]]
    d <- df[!is.na(df[[val]]) & !is.na(df[[grp]]), , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(d) >= 2) {
      p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = reorder(.data[[grp]], .data[[val]]),
                         y = .data[[val]])) +
        geom_col(fill = "#2C6E49", alpha = 0.9) +
        coord_flip() +
        labs(title = title, x = grp, y = val)
      return(style_plot(p))
    }
  }

  # ── Case 7: no Year, multiple numerics → pivot long, bar ──
  if (!has_year && length(info$numeric) >= 2) {
    d <- df
    d$._idx <- seq_len(nrow(d))
    long <- pivot_longer(d, cols = all_of(info$numeric),
                         names_to = "Series", values_to = "Value")
    p <- ggplot(long, aes(x = factor(._idx), y = Value, fill = Series)) +
      geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
      labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL)
    return(style_plot(p))
  }

  NULL
}

style_plot <- function(p) {
  p +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title       = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
    ) +
    scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set2", na.value = "grey50") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", na.value = "grey50")
}

# Human-readable bullets summarising a dataset: period, latest value, direction.
summarise_dataset <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(character())
  out <- character()
  info <- detect_columns(df)

  if (info$has_year) {
    yy <- parse_year(df$Year)
    yy <- yy[!is.na(yy)]
    if (length(yy) > 0) {
      out <- c(out, sprintf("- **Period covered:** %d–%d (%d data point%s).",
                            min(yy), max(yy), length(unique(yy)),
                            if (length(unique(yy)) == 1) "" else "s"))
    } else {
      periods <- unique(as.character(df$Year))
      periods <- periods[!is.na(periods) & nzchar(periods)]
      if (length(periods) > 0) {
        out <- c(out, sprintf("- **Periods covered:** %s (%d).",
                              paste(utils::head(periods, 6), collapse = ", "),
                              length(periods)))
      }
    }
  } else {
    out <- c(out, sprintf("- **Rows in view:** %d.", nrow(df)))
  }

  if (length(info$numeric) >= 1 && info$has_year && info$year_num) {
    val <- info$numeric[[1]]
    yy  <- parse_year(df$Year)
    v   <- as_numeric_safe(df[[val]])
    ord <- order(yy)
    yy2 <- yy[ord]; v2 <- v[ord]
    keep <- !is.na(yy2) & !is.na(v2)
    yy2 <- yy2[keep]; v2 <- v2[keep]
    if (length(v2) >= 2) {
      latest_y <- tail(yy2, 1); latest_v <- tail(v2, 1)
      first_y  <- head(yy2, 1); first_v  <- head(v2, 1)
      delta <- latest_v - first_v
      dir_word <- if (abs(delta) < 1e-9) "flat" else if (delta > 0) "up" else "down"
      out <- c(out, sprintf(
        "- **Most recent value (%s, %d):** %s. Trend since %d: %s.",
        val, latest_y, format(latest_v, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
        first_y, dir_word
      ))
    }
  }
  out
}

md_escape <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x)] <- ""
  gsub("([*_`])", "\\\\\\1", x)
}

source_markdown <- function(r) {
  name <- as.character(r$source_name %||% "")
  url  <- as.character(r$source_url  %||% "")
  if (nzchar(url) && nzchar(name)) return(sprintf("[%s](%s)", name, url))
  if (nzchar(url)) return(sprintf("[%s](%s)", url, url))
  if (nzchar(name)) return(name)
  "_Source not recorded._"
}
```

```{r intro}
cat(sprintf("# About This Report\n\n"))
goal_label <- {
  g <- as.character(params$goal)
  lab <- if (exists("GOAL_LABELS") && g %in% names(GOAL_LABELS)) GOAL_LABELS[[g]] else NULL
  if (is.null(lab) || !nzchar(lab)) paste("Goal", g) else lab
}
cat(sprintf(
  "This internal report summarises data currently available for **%s**.\n\n",
  md_escape(goal_label)
))
if (!is.null(params$yr_start) && !is.null(params$yr_end)) {
  cat(sprintf("_Data shown for %s–%s._\n\n", params$yr_start, params$yr_end))
} else {
  cat("_All available years are shown._\n\n")
}
cat("\\newpage\n\n")
```

```{r goal-summary}
cat("# Goal Summary\n\n")

n_total     <- nrow(goal_rows)
loaded_list <- lapply(seq_len(n_total), function(i) load_dataset(goal_rows[i, , drop = FALSE]))
n_with_data <- sum(vapply(loaded_list, function(x) !is.null(x), logical(1)))

last_updated <- {
  lu <- goal_rows$last_updated
  lu <- lu[!is.na(lu) & nzchar(trimws(lu))]
  if (length(lu) == 0) "Never" else max(lu)
}

summary_df <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Datasets tracked", "Datasets with data", "Most recently updated"),
  Value  = c(n_total, n_with_data, last_updated),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
print(kable(summary_df, col.names = c("Metric", "Value")))
cat("\n")

if (n_total == 0) {
  cat("_No datasets are currently registered under this goal._\n\n")
} else {
  cat("**Datasets included in this report:**\n\n")
  for (i in seq_len(n_total)) {
    r <- goal_rows[i, , drop = FALSE]
    cat(sprintf("- %s\n", md_escape(r$display_name %||% r$dataset)))
  }
  cat("\n")
}
cat("\\newpage\n\n")
```

```{r per-dataset}
if (nrow(goal_rows) == 0) {
  cat("# Data by Dataset\n\n_No datasets available._\n")
} else {
  cat("# Data by Dataset\n\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(goal_rows))) {
    r  <- goal_rows[i, , drop = FALSE]
    df <- loaded_list[[i]]

    cat(sprintf("## %s\n\n", md_escape(r$display_name %||% r$dataset)))

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      cat("_No data file found for this dataset yet._\n\n")
      next
    }

    df <- filter_years(df)
    if (nrow(df) == 0) {
      cat("_No data in the selected year range._\n\n")
      next
    }

    bullets <- summarise_dataset(df)
    if (length(bullets) > 0) {
      cat(paste(bullets, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n", sep = "")
    }
    cat(sprintf("- **Source:** %s\n\n", source_markdown(r)))

    p <- tryCatch(build_chart(df, r$display_name %||% r$dataset),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(p)) {
      print(p)
      cat("\n\n")
    } else {
      # Only show a small table if the chart can't be rendered — keep it tight.
      snap <- utils::head(df, 8)
      print(kable(snap, caption = sprintf("%s — first rows",
                                          r$display_name %||% r$dataset)))
      cat("\n")
    }
    cat("\\newpage\n\n")
  }
}
```
